ItemID: unavailable; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Home monitoring interests me, but I recently added a Blink camera and would wait until I need another camera.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display appeals to me, but I would choose the larger Echo Show 8 rather than buy both.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interests center on home viewing and monitoring, with no immediate need for an in-car assistant.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could complement my home setup, but I do not currently have a specific appliance I want to automate.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have recently invested in TV viewing equipment and do not currently need another screen for portable viewing.
